flashcard_questions.q: A thick, dark mixture of hydrocarbons formed over millions of years from the fossilised remains of ancient marine organisms buried under layers of rock.
Compounds made up of hydrogen and carbon atoms only.
Two or more substances mixed together that are not chemically bonded and can be separated by physical methods.

flashcard_questions.a: A group of hydrocarbons with similar chain lengths and boiling points, separated from crude oil by fractional distillation.
A family of saturated hydrocarbons with single bonds only, with the general formula CnH2n+2.
